write_probe_query: BEGIN; UPDATE public.songs SET title = title WHERE false; ROLLBACK; SELECT current_user AS database_role, current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS transaction_read_only, has_table_privilege(current_user, 'public.songs', 'INSERT') AS songs_insert, has_table_privilege(current_user, 'public.songs', 'UPDATE') AS songs_update, has_table_privilege(current_user, 'public.songs', 'DELETE') AS songs_delete, has_schema_privilege(current_user, 'public', 'CREATE') AS public_schema_create, 'zero-row UPDATE executed and transaction rolled back' AS write_probe;
